# Images Directory  

Place your motorcycle thumbnail images here:

- ninja-300-thumb.jpg
- ninja-400-thumb.jpg
- ninja-650-thumb.jpg  
- ninja-zx6r-thumb.jpg
- ninja-zx10r-thumb.jpg

## Specifications

- Format: JPG, PNG, or WebP
- Size: 400x300px recommended
- Aspect Ratio: 4:3 (landscape)
- Optimization: Keep file sizes under 100KB for best performance

## Note

These thumbnail images are optional. If not provided, the bike selector cards will display placeholder icons instead.
